'Game of Thrones: Aegon's Conquest' is an upcoming American action adventure fantasy drama film from a screenplay by Beau Willimon. It is an adaptation of the HBO fantasy drama television series Game of Thrones, itself an adaptation of the A Song of Ice and Fire series of fantasy novels by George R. R. Martin.
Production
In late October 2024, Warner Bros. Pictures announced that a Game of Thrones feature film was in early development, with no filmmakers or cast attached. In March 2026, Beau Willimon had been hired to pen the screenplay, which was indicated to be a prequel. In April, during CinemaCon, the title was announced as ''Game of Thrones: Aegon's Conquest''.
